title: An unreachable portal is declined; hidden where a WO hides it
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a user with BOTH Part sales -> Create & Edit AND Invoicing & payments -> Create & Edit, on the build under test.
  2. A customer to sell to exists; if none does, create one first: Customers -> New Customer (e.g. "4 Star Truck Repair").
  3. A part sale in Estimate, Approved or Complete status. Seed it: Part Sales -> New Part Sale, select the customer (e.g. "4 Star Truck Repair"), add a part (Add Part), and open the Finance tab.
  4. Two conditions to test: (a) the Customer Portal cannot be reached; (b) the shop does not take online payments OR the user has no Customer Portal access.
custom_steps:
1. With the portal unreachable, open the Create Deposit dialog and read the Collect in Portal state, then confirm Record Deposit still works.
  2. With the shop not taking online payments (or the user lacking portal access), open the dialog and look for Collect in Portal.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • When the portal cannot be reached, the handoff is treated as declined and Collect in Portal stays disabled; recording the deposit is unaffected.
  • When the shop takes no online payments or the user has no Customer Portal access, Collect in Portal is not rendered at all (matching the work order); the disabled-with-reason state is only for a portal that is asked and actively declines.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667 (Founder Mode Batch #1); story SV-10269 (Take a deposit on a part sale); Part Sales Update v1 PRD (Confluence 867434569), Story 8; design canvas boards S8_*; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-N3: “If the Customer Portal cannot be reached, the handoff is treated as declined and stays disabled. Recording the deposit is unaffected”
  • S8-N5: “Collect in Portal is not rendered at all when the shop does not take online payments, or when the user has no Customer Portal access ... S8-R10's disabled-with-reason state is only for a portal that is asked and actively declines”
